A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same KL-Shampoo/KL-SOAP work. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and complete appendices are readable and support reliable matching across relocations and renumbering.

before.justification: v5 reports original language-model training experiments, optimizer comparisons, and ablations in Sections 6 and H.

after.justification: v8 retains these original experiments and adds a Llama3-450M comparison with SOAP and Muon in Appendix H, Figure 9.

M1.justification: The practical algorithm's stated stabilization options change from damping or pseudo-inverse in v5 Figure 11 to damping or clipping in v8 Figure 12. The central Kronecker-factor updates, eigenvalue EMA, QR procedure, and preconditioning remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate language-model pretraining on FineWeb, C4, and OpenWebText. The added Llama3-450M experiment uses FineWeb again; its larger model and token budget change experimental settings without introducing a distinct dataset population or task.

E2.justification: v8 Figure 9 adds an evaluated Muon comparator, attributed to Liu et al. (2025), alongside SOAP and KL-Shampoo. Muon is absent from v5's comparisons. Comparator membership in the retained experiments is unchanged.

E3.justification: v8 adds a Llama3-450M/FineWeb-3.3B experiment with 120 random-search runs per method and QR every 10 iterations using FP32. The existing experiments retain their model configurations, data budgets, schedules, and two-stage 150-run searches.

E4.justification: The grafting, instantaneous-versus-EMA eigenvalue, divergence-choice, and F-Shampoo/VN-Shampoo variant analyses are retained. The additional larger-model comparison supplies benchmark evidence rather than a new ablation or robustness analysis.

E5.justification: Neither version reports seed-replicated uncertainty estimates, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The new 120-run random search is a hyperparameter-tuning budget, not a change in statistical uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: The retained experimental curves are unchanged. New v8 Figure 9 reports that KL-Shampoo and Muon outperform SOAP on Llama3-450M, with KL-Shampoo better than Muon per iteration but worse in wall-clock efficiency. These are additional-setting results, not improvements over matched v5 runs.

T1.justification: Appendix G corrects the final Adafactor normalization expression following Claim 7 by replacing traces of row/column vectors with sums. The formal claims and proof structure otherwise remain substantially unchanged; Appendix C's new Bregman-duality annotation explains an existing step.

C1.justification: The introduction narrows its superiority wording from other methods in the experiments to other Shampoo variants as Muon enters the evaluation. The introduction and conclusion also foreground the existing unifying framework. The central KL reinterpretation, tensor applicability, memory, and runtime claims remain.

C2.justification: New Figure 9 acknowledges Muon's wall-clock advantage, identifies QR as the bottleneck, and suggests untested runtime remedies. Section 6 additionally interprets the retained VN-Shampoo-versus-F-Shampoo ordering as evidence that respecting the SPD constraint is essential.

D1.justification: v8 adds a code link on the title page. Figure 12 newly documents storing inverse-square-root eigenvalues in bfloat16 and explicitly distinguishes KL-Shampoo's original-space momentum from KL-SOAP's rotated-space momentum. These disclosures do not establish changes to previously run experiments.

R1.justification: v8 expands the quasi-Newton historical discussion with Greenstadt (1968), Dennis and Moré (1977), and Güler et al. (2009). It also adds references for Muon and mixed-precision linear algebra. The broader positioning around KL covariance estimation is retained.

P1.justification: The introduction and KL-divergence motivation receive localized rewrites, terminology is refined, and acknowledgements are added. Most prose and the overall section hierarchy remain intact.

P2.justification: v8 adds the two-panel Figure 9, relocates Table 1 and Figures 4–5, and renumbers subsequent appendix figures. Several captions and Table 2's column heading are revised, while existing plots and the overall visual design are retained.

improvement.justification: The larger-model Muon comparison adds useful empirical context and explicitly exposes the wall-clock tradeoff. The code link, practical numerical details, and Appendix G correction improve reproducibility and accuracy. These are limited gains: existing evidence remains largely unchanged, proposed QR speedups are untested, and the stronger SPD interpretation exceeds what the comparison alone establishes.
